advance_queue.prompt: Arcade-machine credit-added jingle: a single coin dropping into a metal slot followed by a short ascending 3-note chiptune bleep (Game Boy / FreeBoy square wave, ~C5→E5→G5, 80ms per note) confirming the credit registered. Bright, satisfying, 'I just got another turn to spend'. ~0.45s total, mono, normalize to -14 LUFS. Replaces the prior tonal-gunshot prompt the user disliked.

advance_fighter_1.prompt: Fighter advance press 1 (STEEL interpretation) — single confident blade tap + a touch of low body, present and clear. Essence: Resolve, the weapon readied and held. Ladder tier 1/3, ~-17.5 dB mean (loud floor; the drum-v1 tier-1 was too quiet in-game).

advance_fighter_2.prompt: Fighter advance press 2 (STEEL) — sword drawn (metallic slide into ring) + shield braced with weight + sub. Heavier, closer. Tier 2/3, ~-14.7 dB.

advance_fighter_3.prompt: Fighter advance press 3 full ham (STEEL) — full draw + a big ringing steel CLANG (sustained, spectrally verified 65% high-mid tail) over the shield thunk + sub punch. The ring is the payoff. Tier 3/3, ~-13.9 dB, PCM peak -0.8.

advance_cleric_1.prompt: Cleric advance press 1 — soft latch-click, a genuine PAUSE (the half-second before the prayer, cowir-story), then a single warm tubular-bell chime over an open church-organ fifth. Essence: Faith. Tier 1/3, ~-18 dB (present floor).

advance_cleric_2.prompt: Cleric advance press 2 — pause SHORTENS (she's surer), bell chime + B over a SUSPENDED organ chord (Csus, unresolved tension). Tier 2/3, ~-13 dB.

advance_cleric_3.prompt: Cleric advance press 3 full ham — tiny pause, then the suspension RESOLVES: full C-major chord (organ + choir Aahs) + a bright tubular-bell peal ringing out (spectral-verified C-E-G-C-E). 'Teaches wounds to be over with.' Tier 3/3, ~-12 dB.

advance_rogue_1.prompt: Rogue advance press 1 — bright confident coin-flick + a tiny lockpick pre-tick. Essence: Edge, 'the click that was, more than anything, over.' The rogue's ladder INVERTS (loudest here). Tier 1/3, ~-14 dB.

advance_rogue_2.prompt: Rogue advance press 2 — QUIETER: lockpick tick + a softer coin. The inversion recedes. Tier 2/3, ~-17 dB.

advance_rogue_3.prompt: Rogue advance press 3 'ham' = the QUIETEST — faint pick + a coin spinning down to rest (spectral-verified metallic settle). Drama as conspicuous quiet, 'the second thing in the room, heard.' Tier 3/3, ~-20 dB. NOTE for cowir-battle: lands best if the engine ducks other audio under it.

advance_mage_1.prompt: Mage advance press 1 — single clean CORRECT celesta chime, precise, no error (he's sure). Essence: Logic / forensic mathematics. Arcane crystalline interpretation. Tier 1/3, ~-15 dB.

advance_mage_2.prompt: Mage advance press 2 — a WRONG celesta chime (F#5), then the RIGHT one (G5) re-strikes over its shimmer: 'No—wait. Then it's the other thing.' Revision without flinching; the wrong note stays hearable. Tier 2/3, ~-13 dB.

advance_mage_3.prompt: Mage advance press 3 full ham — an ascending cascade of celesta computations (C-E-G-B), the LAST one self-corrects (C#6 wrong -> D6 right) and rings out. Tier 3/3, ~-11 dB.

advance_bard_1.prompt: Bard advance press 1 — a soft breath (she LISTENS first), then a single warm lute note. Speaks once. Essence: Voice / the Unwritten Chord. Tier 1/3, ~-18 dB.

advance_bard_2.prompt: Bard advance press 2 — a lute flourish + a bright piano note SLICED off mid-decay (the piano_scythe cutting it short). Tier 2/3, ~-15 dB.

advance_bard_3.prompt: Bard advance press 3 full ham — a rising gesture into the UNWRITTEN CHORD: a lush Cmaj9(#11) that hangs, beautiful but refuses to resolve the way the ear predicts (un-hummable). Per cowir-story canon. Tier 3/3, ~-13 dB.

night_crickets_wind.prompt: Soft nighttime forest ambience — subtle wind rustling through leaves, distant cricket chirps in a natural rhythm, occasional very soft owl hoot far away. Low-level ambient bed suitable for seamless looping. No sudden transients, no bass rumble, no percussive elements. Consistent quiet level throughout the entire duration.

round_ap_gain.prompt: Round-boundary AP+1 chime — coin-metallic click (bandpass noise + 3200/2400Hz sine ping) into ascending arpeggio C5-E5-G5-C6 (triangle+square) with a shimmer tail bending 1047->1300Hz. Bright, celebratory, ~370ms. Per struktured msg 2686: 'coin-meets-charge-up' for BattleScene._show_round_banner (replaces placeholder menu_select at fold time). NO fallback_to — double-fire prevention per thump-family convention.

purchase_complete.prompt: Purchase-confirmation ka-ching for ShopScene (struktured msg 2774) — coins clinking + warm register-bell confirm. 4 metallic coin pings at 2400/3200/2800/3600 Hz staggered 18-68ms, then a warm 320 Hz confirm tone + 640 Hz octave harm + soft 200 Hz drawer-thump, gentle echo tail. ~410ms. Deliberately distinct from item_obtain (that's the celebration chord for chests/rewards; this is COMMERCE). NO fallback_to — cowir-overworld consumes with a manifest-has guard.

strike_fire.prompt: Fire-element weapon strike voice (msg 2789 axis A). Layers under attack_hit_<weapon> when equipped weapon has special_effects.fire_damage_bonus. Crackling pinknoise (bandpass 3000/1800Hz) + rising 800->1600Hz sine sweep. Ember-pop character mid-air. ~140ms.

strike_ice.prompt: Ice-element weapon strike voice. Crystalline 3400Hz sine + 6800Hz harmonic + brittle bandpass noise click (3500-2000Hz). Shattering-glass character. ~125ms.

strike_lightning.prompt: Lightning-element weapon strike voice. Sharp 6000Hz snap + 100Hz square-wave buzz decay + bandpass noise (4500/3000Hz). Electric-arc character. ~90ms.

strike_holy.prompt: Holy-element weapon strike voice. Bright bell 1568Hz + harmonics at 3136Hz + 4704Hz + soft high shimmer (bandpass 5000-3000Hz). Radiant-chord character. ~180ms.

strike_dark.prompt: Dark-element weapon strike voice. Hollow 165Hz + 82Hz sub pad + reverse pinknoise swell (void whoosh). ~175ms.

weakness_flash.prompt: Weakness-hit stinger — fires when elemental_mod > 1.0 (msg 2789 axis D + cowir-battle msg 2787 visual pair). Bright ascending 1200->2400Hz sweep + 3600Hz top + shatter-noise bandpass (5000/3000Hz) + high click (bandpass 6500/3500Hz) + gentle echo. Punches through the mix. ~235ms.

status_burn.prompt: Burn-status application cue (cycle #10 pre-stage — beats cowir-battle's ratchet msg 2797 before burn_chance lands on any weapon). Sustained pinknoise sizzle (bandpass 3000/2000Hz) + 200->350Hz rising heat body + 4 fire pops staggered 120/310/490/640ms. Threatening, sustained. Distinct from strike_fire (that's 140ms punchy; this is 800ms afflicted-by-fire). ~800ms.

status_freeze.prompt: Freeze-status application cue (cycle #10 pre-stage). Ice crackle (bandpass 4500/3500Hz) + crystalline 2400+4800Hz sustained body + descending 200->150Hz sub shudder + glass tinkle at 100ms. Brittle, cold, distinct from strike_ice (that's 125ms punch; this is 840ms frozen-solid). ~840ms.

w4_enemy_death.prompt: W4 industrial enemy-death variant. RENAMED from enemy_death_industrial (cycle #13): the world-variant scheme is wN_<base>, so the suffix shape could never be found by _get_world_sfx_prefix() — this sound had never played once since authoring. Paired with making play_battle() world-prefix-aware, same as play_ability already was.

windup_swing_med.prompt: PROTOTYPE for struktured's verdict (cowir-main msg 2914) — medium/sword-weight melee windup. Fills the 0.12s EASE_IN approach tween that currently plays SILENT before hitstop (cowir-battle msg 2910), so it adds anticipation without adding latency. Filtered pinknoise air-swell (bandpass 1200/900) + 180->300Hz accelerating-mass tone + faint 2200->3400Hz steel-edge shimmer. Deliberately 2.9 dB UNDER attack_hit_sword so anticipation stays subordinate to impact. INERT — no consumer until struktured rules; if he greenlights, light/heavy variants are trivial follow-ons.

inn_rest.prompt: Inn rest — 'sleep through the night and wake restored' (cowir-main GO, msg 2950). Replaces generic `heal` at VillageInn, which is 83% brilliance at 10kHz and reads as clinical magic sparkle rather than relief. Structure: soft 165Hz settle (lying down) -> C3+G3 open-fifth night pad with lowpassed air (deliberately UNRESOLVED) -> rising E4-G4-C5 waking figure that resolves the fifth to the octave, faint 1046Hz morning shimmer on the last note. Warm triangles, no harsh transients. 1.38s, inside VillageInn's 1.5s pre-close window.

status_stun.prompt: Stun-status application. 18 shipped abilities inflict `stun` (shield_bash, ground_pound, crystal_slam, horn_charge, ...) and it had NO key — all 18 fell to play_status's generic descending blip. Concussive by design and deliberately unlike status_paralyze (which is an electric zap, 70% brilliance @8.5kHz): 90Hz thud + 150Hz body + bandpassed crack, then an 880/1320Hz tremolo ring that decays — the 'seeing stars' daze. ~640ms.

status_blind.prompt: Blind-status application (smoke_bomb, sand_strike, sandstorm). Vision closing: highpassed white-noise smear + 1400->300Hz descending tone, whole thing lowpassed to 2.2kHz so it audibly shuts down rather than sparkles. ~450ms.

duel_answer_dodge.prompt: W6 Arbiter-duel answer cue (cowir-battle msg 3223/3226). Canon: each attack is a QUESTION; dodge is evasion, block is deflection, only a committed strike is an answer. The three share one tonal centre (C) so they read as answers to the same question, and commitment is audible as a 4dB ladder. No damage exists in this encounter, so these carry the entire action-feedback surface. DODGE: bare G5 fifth, high and thin, 0.06% bass — rootless and unresolved. mean -19.9.

duel_answer_block.prompt: W6 Arbiter-duel answer cue (cowir-battle msg 3223/3226). Canon: each attack is a QUESTION; dodge is evasion, block is deflection, only a committed strike is an answer. The three share one tonal centre (C) so they read as answers to the same question, and commitment is audible as a 4dB ladder. No damage exists in this encounter, so these carry the entire action-feedback surface. BLOCK: B4 leading tone + body — wants to resolve to C and stops short. mean -15.5.

duel_answer_strike.prompt: W6 Arbiter-duel answer cue (cowir-battle msg 3223/3226). Canon: each attack is a QUESTION; dodge is evasion, block is deflection, only a committed strike is an answer. The three share one tonal centre (C) so they read as answers to the same question, and commitment is audible as a 4dB ladder. No damage exists in this encounter, so these carry the entire action-feedback surface. STRIKE: resolves to tonic — C root+fifth+octave over a sub, rings out. 27.7% bass, dominant 262Hz. The only cue that arrives. mean -11.8.
